summary: Inhibrx Biosciences filed an 8-K disclosing a second amendment to its existing loan and security agreement with Oxford Finance LLC, expanding the credit facility to an aggregate principal amount of up to $500 million. The amendment provides an additional tranche of $325 million in gross proceeds, with $100 million funded immediately as the Term C Loan and up to $225 million available at the lenders' discretion as the Term D Loan. In connection with the Term C Loan, the company issued warrants to purchase 21,457 shares at $93.21 per share, exercisable for ten years. The filing also notes a pledge of equity securities in Poplar Therapeutics, Inc. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
